name: Outlands
source:
Outlands is a visual novel based on the world of Wild-Life, another video game created by Adeptus Steve. This story includes adult content such as bad-sounding words or sexual scenes.

In Outlands you will live the story of Max, the commander of a ship sent to explore the atmosphere of an alien planet.  During the descent of the ship, it falls, crashing into the planet's surface and leaving the ship completely unusable.

Outlands is set in a world where, due to pollution, humans have been forced to abandon planet Earth. For years, humans have wandered the universe in search of a planet on which to build a new civilization.

[From [url=https://xcuality.itch.io/outlands]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Outlands》是一部基于《Wild-Life》世界的视觉小说，《Wild-Life》是Adeptus Steve创作的另一款电子游戏。该故事包含成人内容，例如难听的词语或性场景。

在《外域》中，你将体验到麦克斯的故事，他是一艘被派去探索外星球大气层的船的指挥官。在飞船下降的过程中，它坠落并坠入行星表面，使飞船完全无法使用。

《外域》的故事发生在一个由于污染，人类被迫放弃地球的世界。多年来，人类一直在宇宙中徘徊，寻找一个可以在其上建立新文明的星球。

[来自[url=https://xcuality.itch.io/outlands]Itch.io[/url]]
